title: Nutritious Roasted Mediterranean Duck Skewers
description: A low-calorie, post-workout Mediterranean dish featuring roasted duck skewers with duck sauce and nuka-pickle, served in a copper mug.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the duck breast pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together the duck sauce, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Brush the mixture onto the duck skewers, making sure they are fully coated.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the duck is shattering and slightly charred.
While the duck is cooking, prepare the nuka-pickle by chopping it into small pieces.
Once the duck is done, remove it from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes.
Serve the duck skewers in copper mugs, topped with chopped nuka-pickle and a side of duck sauce for dipping.
